name: Love Of Neighbor
overview: Scripture commands believers to love their neighbors as themselves, emphasizing this as a fundamental and enduring principle. Leviticus 19:18 establishes this command as a divine mandate, prohibiting vengeance and grudges among God's people. Jesus reaffirms its importance in Matthew 22:39 and Mark 12:31, highlighting it as second only to loving God and calling it the greatest commandment after the first. Furthermore, John 13:34 deepens this call by instructing believers to love one another with the same sacrificial love Christ has shown, setting a new standard for Christian community.
